sloka: वासम् कृत्वा सर्व तीर्थे तीर्त्वा च उत्तानकाम् नदीम् ।अन्या नदीः च विविधाः पार्वतीयैअः तुरम् गमैः ॥२-७१-१४॥
transliteration: vāsam kṛtvā sarva tīrthe tīrtvā ca uttānakām nadīm ।anyā nadīḥ ca vividhāḥ pārvatīyaiaḥ turam gamaiḥ ॥2-71-14॥

translations.english: ﻿ That tiger among men, Bharata halted at a place known as Sarvatirtha and crossed the Uttanika and various other rivers with the help of hillborn horses. He crossed the Kutika river on an elephant the river Kapivati at a place known as Lauhitya.
translations.hindi: महाराज काले लोहे के पीडे पर काले वस्न पहिने हुए बैठे हैं और काली तथा पीले रंग की ( पोशाक पहने हुए ) खनिया उनका उपहास कर रही हैं
